scope: October 13, 2025 Law: common rules, Standard Setup, four base factions, Fall/Autumn and Winter, Thief/Tinker/Ranger, core dominance/coalitions. Excludes expansions, second Vagabond, other characters/maps, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.
method: Full candidate10 read, including a separate read of the portion truncated in initial tool output. Exact diff against assigned candidate09 reviewed. Every revised claim independently rechecked against authoritative extracted Law and PDF text, with explicit inference analysis for immediate use of own-crafted Vagabond items. Full unchanged applicable-source checks were completed earlier in this same independent audit session, without reading audit reports. Only assigned snapshots and authoritative sources read; no questions, keys, readers/grades/adjudications or other reviews. No summary edits.

checked_claims.claim_group: Crafting cost source and normal activation
checked_claims.checked: Bottom-left crafting icons, not card suit, determine cost. One matching piece per icon, clearing provides suit, workshop/roost/sympathy identities; pieces can combine, each piece once per turn.

Every icon costs exhaustion of one face-up undamaged hammer; pawn current clearing must match every icon; pawn activation can repeat, distinct hammer payment still needed each time; mixed fox/rabbit/mouse impossible in one clearing and question mark accepts any suit.

Ordinary item goes from map supply to the crafting faction’s own Crafted Items box. The exception explicitly applies when Vagabond itself crafts: it takes that own-crafted item face up into Satchel/track. Statement does not authorize taking another faction’s craft for free.

Supported consequence: own-crafted item is gained face up, items may pay listed Daylight actions in any order/number, and no waiting turn/phase is imposed. Phrase is qualified by action cost and all other requirements. Another action follows completion of Craft; ordinary no-interrupt rule remains in the summary. No free action, readying of previously exhausted items, extra refresh/draw, or supply/target/cost exception is granted.

checked_claims.claim_group: Mobilize one hand card and incoming cap
checked_claims.checked: One hand card added; no base means at most five and incoming excess discarded; any base means unlimited stack. Does not authorize replacement of an existing supporter.
Hand card matching base clearing places supply warrior into Officers box; supporters are separate and do not pay Train.

Up to number of officers military operations, with no officer removal/exhaustion payment. Each officer permits one operation toward the total, in any order/repetition, rather than one of each named type.
Four choices Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize; unchanged table retains one move, one battle, one warrior at base, or warrior removal for sympathy/VP.
After operations draw one plus uncovered draw bonuses, then discard to five. Added prose agrees with retained sentence below table.
Two VP for subsequent Aid; one ally may be forced to move, retaining own movement restrictions and Outrage; alone moves cannot carry ally warriors.

checked_claims.claim_group: Allied Attack prose cap and restrictions
checked_claims.checked: At battle start as attacker treat warriors of one Allied faction in clearing as own; maximum rolled hits equals that faction’s participating warriors plus total undamaged swords, including exhausted swords. Cannot attack that faction using its own warriors; no change to defender benefits or ordinary dice result.
All independently checked base component/setup quantities, R/S/map item distinction and hidden-ruin randomization, ordering, corner placement, faction tracks, reach and Fall/Winter rules retained.

Retains previously independently checked timings, interrupts, information, suits, ownership, rule and adjacency, movement, battle ordering/caps/extra hits, removal sequencing and maximum possible finite pieces/destinations.
Retains keep/hospitals, wood and full costs, actions/Recruit limit, Eyrie special rules and Decree matching/full completion, turmoil and all Evening scoring/draw, leaders.
Retains supporters/Outrage/base-loss, Revolt-before-spread timing, matching payments, no added base-placement prerequisite, printed suit count, Martial Law, Organize restrictions and scoring.

Retains item states/tracks, refresh/Slip/forest movement, actions and requirements, relationships and Hostile/Infamy, allied casualty conversion, Rest/draw/capacity and base character starting items/specials.

checked_claims.claim_group: Ordinary removal points and separate Infamy
checked_claims.checked: Warrior ordinary removal 0, enemy building/token 1 each. Own-turn battle Infamy is additional for eligible Hostile pieces with first hostility-causing warrior excluded. Prior explicit clarification unchanged and still correct.

Retains immediate 30 and simultaneous tie order, dominance activation/payment/suits/Birdsong timing, coalition 4+ player/10 VP own Daylight/lowest partner/shared win and Hostile reset without automatic Allied powers.

snapshot_fidelity.comparison: Only crafting cost table-to-prose, clarification of own-craft item routing, Alliance Mobilize/Train/Evening prose, own-crafted Vagabond immediate-use qualification, and Allied benefits table-to-prose changed; remaining text matches candidate09.

source_gaps.gap: Exact physical faction-board cost/VP/draw tracks and relationship Aid thresholds/advancement VP are referenced, not reproduced, in the supplied Law. Summary correctly refers to printed spaces; no values invented.
Complete shared-deck and quest card faces are absent; exact individual costs/effects and quest item pairs require cards. General procedures are supported.
60–90 minute catalog duration is not stated in the supplied Law and remains unverified metadata, not a gameplay-rule finding.

conclusion: All revisions supported; immediate-use sentence is a qualified consequence of face-up gain and unrestricted Daylight action order, not an extra action permission or timing exception. No material contradiction or important in-scope procedural omission found.
